entries.name: com.apple.nexusd
entries.note: Home accessory hub service that routes accessory events and voice requests. Matter setup codes, discovery and interaction are in matter.rs and matter_interaction.rs. Not built: the hub service that keeps accessories and routes voice commands. Built 2026-10-17: the hub model (springboard/core/src/matter_hub.rs) keeps accessories with their room and clusters, tracks the On/Off state applied to each, and routes on/off requests by name and room; tests matter_hub::tests. Still missing: the hub service that runs on the network and sends the routed commands. Reviewed 2026-10-17 (wave 13): left partial. The index shows only usr/libexec/nexusd, the plist and empty Nexus and NexusDaemon framework shells, so the role is taken from the earlier reading (accessory hub). What is missing is the Matter controller transport (commissioning sessions, discovery and the encrypted message layer) that sends the commands matter_hub routes; that is a whole engine, not a row-sized change.

entries.name: com.apple.notes.exchangenotesd
entries.note: Syncs Notes with Exchange accounts. Built 2026-10-17: SDK exchange_notes.rs (EWS FindItem, GetItem, CreateItem, UpdateItem, DeleteItem against the notes folder; tests exchange_notes::tests). Wired 2026-10-17 (wave 14): Settings > Internet Accounts > Notes (Exchange) and the Notes app (exchange.rs, Sync in the SDK).
entries.ready_note: The user path: Settings > Internet Accounts > Add Account > Notes (Exchange) takes an https:// server address, a user name and a password (saved in Passwords), and the account lists a Notes switch. The Notes app reads the first such account on start, every five minutes and from Note > Sync Exchange Notes (password through the passwords store, network on a worker thread): the mailbox's Notes folder becomes a Notes folder named after the account, local edits, new notes and deletions are sent (delete moves the item to Deleted Items), and a note open in the editor is not replaced. Tested with canned server answers (no live Exchange server); verify against a real mailbox on Midget.

entries.name: com.apple.spotlightknowledged.importer
entries.note: Index importers. Built 2026-10-17: importer plug-ins (bifrost_ui mdimport), file-to-item conversion (spotindex::file_item), the bounded folder scan (spotindex::scan_folder_limited, reindex_folder) and the importer daemon (shell file_import): at shell start and every 30 seconds the tick starts one background thread that compares a cheap change signature of Documents, Desktop and Downloads and re-imports only the folders that changed, a third of the per-app budget each, under the Files app. Missing: importers for binary formats, and the folders are fixed (no Settings list of Search locations); a change is noticed within one period, not at once, since the shell has no file-change feed.
entries.ready_note: The shell imports Documents, Desktop and Downloads into the Core Search index on a background thread, at start and when a folder's signature changes, bounded by depth, file count and a per-folder share (tests file_import, spotindex). Binary-format importers are not built.
